_meta.discipline: This file holds API identifiers and curated display labels ONLY — zero factual claim values. Every stored fact (official titles, public law numbers, sponsors, enactment years, cosponsor counts) is fetched live from Congress.gov / GovInfo by scripts/loadProgramOrigins.js at load time. A program appears here only if its FETCHED official title supports the program claim (47-01/47-02 probes; unconfirmable candidates are in _skipped).

tiers.modern: Congress.gov v3 bill detail (structured coverage begins 93rd Congress, 1973) — full field set incl. sponsor and cosponsors
tiers.foundational: GovInfo STATUTE granule — official title, public law citation, enactment date; sponsor fields stay NULL with an honest boundary note (no structured sponsor data exists for pre-1973 laws)

_meta.law_record: For modern bills whose public law predates the GovInfo PLAW collection (starts 104th Congress, 1995), law_record pins the Statutes-at-Large granule used for public_law_url; the loader verifies it exists at run time.
_meta.additional_claims: Identifier-only pointers fetched at load time and stored in details jsonb as {field, value, source_url} — used where a second act maps to an already-occupied node (UNIQUE one-program-per-node).
